what: blaze-image: (1) add `SectionId::SYNTAX_TREES = SectionId(0x0600)` with name "the library syntax trees" (lane tree-store stores library files parsed trees there, schema `base_db::trees::SCHEMA`). (2) a safe way to make a `blaze_bytes::Bytes` of a section checked by `Image::whole`, holding the `Arc<Image<Mapping>>` alive (blaze-vfs does this with a private unsafe `mapped_bytes`; one public helper in blaze-image, e.g. `Image::section_bytes(self: &Arc<Self>, id, schema) -> Result<Bytes, Refused>`, keeps one mapping layer for tree-store and graph). The bytes must start 8-aligned in the mapping.

history.note: crates/blaze-image: SectionId::SYNTAX_TREES = 0x0600 ("the library syntax trees"); Image::whole_bytes(self: &Arc<Self>, &Section) -> Result<Bytes, Corrupt> (image.rs): every group checked, the Bytes hold the Arc<Image>, refused as Misaligned unless 8-aligned (an empty section is Bytes::default()). Get the Section with image.section(id, schema), which gives Refused. blaze-bytes dependency (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock). Test whole_bytes_keep_the_image_and_are_the_section.
